get.summary: Find people by username or name, or list the newest members
get.description: Signed-in only. Matches usernames that start with `q` and names with a word that starts with `q`, ignoring case; an exact username comes first. Without `q`, the newest members. Leaves out you and deleted accounts.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The start of a username, or of any word in a name. Leave out for the newest members.

engagements.description: Likes and comments the posts have received

post.summary: Upload one photo for a post you are about to make
post.description: Send the image itself with Content-Type image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp, up to 8 MB. It is saved as WebP, at most 1440 pixels on its long side, without its metadata, with copies 320 and 640 pixels wide in `smaller`. Pass the returned id in `mediaIds` when creating the post. Photos not used in a post within a day are deleted.
